P. 1</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 44</ls>; <ls>Me. 72</ls>; <ls>Ki. 11. 44</ls>. .²5 Bursting into view; कदम्बयष्टिः स्फुटकोरकेव <ls>U. 3. 42</ls>. .²6 White, bright, pure; मुक्ताफलं वा स्फुटविद्रुमस्थम् <ls>Ku. 1. 44</ls>. .²7 Well-known, famous; स्फुटनृत्यलीलमभवत् सुतनोः <ls>Śi. 9. 79</ls> (= प्रथित). .²8 Spread, diffused. .²9 Loud. .²10 Apparent, true. .²11 Corrected. .²12 Extraordinary, strange. .{@-टा, -टः@} The expanded hood of a snake. .{@-टम्@} {%ind.%} Clearly, evidently, distinctly, certainly, manifestly.
